items.text: A fallen power line near Washington, DC flipped over 3GW of data centers onto backup power within 30 seconds, spiking PJM grid voltage and exposing AI buildout risks.
items.text_zh: 华盛顿特区附近一根电线坠落，30 秒内超 3GW 数据中心集体切换备用电源，导致 PJM 电网电压骤升，暴露 AI 数据中心扩建的电网风险。

items.text: Tencent's AI work assistant WorkBuddy launched natively on Huawei's App Gallery for HarmonyOS PCs, extending Tencent's AI productivity tools to Huawei's desktop ecosystem.
items.text_zh: 腾讯 AI 办公助手 WorkBuddy 原生适配鸿蒙电脑并上架华为 App Gallery，将腾讯 AI 生产力工具带入华为桌面生态。

items.text: China produced 18.58 million service robots in 2025, up 16.1% year on year, according to official statistics.
items.text_zh: 官方数据显示，2025 年中国服务机器人产量达 1858.1 万套，同比增长 16.1%。

items.text: D2iQ co-founder Tobi Knaup argues open-weight AI is having its 'Kubernetes moment,' noting Chinese models drew 41% of Hugging Face downloads and urging US labs to open frontier weights.
items.text_zh: D2iQ 联合创始人 Tobi Knaup 撰文称开源权重 AI 正迎来“Kubernetes 时刻”：中国模型已占 Hugging Face 下载量的 41%，呼吁美国实验室开放前沿模型权重。

items.text: SCMP examines whether 'supernode' architectures that densely interconnect hundreds of domestic AI chips can break China's compute bottlenecks under US export controls.
items.text_zh: 《南华早报》分析“超节点”架构——将数百颗国产 AI 芯片高密度互联——能否突破美国出口管制下中国的算力瓶颈。

items.text: 3D-generation startup Tripo posted a SIGGRAPH 2026 recap, reporting week-long artist and developer traffic at its booth after keynoting on generative 3D and world models.
items.text_zh: 3D 生成公司 Tripo 发布 SIGGRAPH 2026 回顾：在发表生成式 3D 与世界模型主题演讲后，其展台整周吸引艺术家与开发者到访交流。

items.text: Kuaishou's KwaiKAT team released KAT-Coder-V2.5, an agentic coding model trained on 100,000+ verifiable repository environments, scoring 94.9 on PinchBench, with an Apache-2.0 open 35B-A3B Dev variant.
items.text_zh: 快手 KwaiKAT 团队发布 KAT-Coder-V2.5，该 agentic 编程模型在超 10 万个可验证仓库环境中训练，PinchBench 得分 94.9，并以 Apache-2.0 协议开源 35B-A3B 的 Dev 版本。

items.text: Claude Opus 5 scored 30.2% on ARC-AGI-3, nearly quadrupling the 7.8% record set by OpenAI's GPT-5.6 Sol (Max), which the ARC Prize team credits to stronger autonomous exploration.
items.text_zh: Claude Opus 5 在 ARC-AGI-3 基准上拿下 30.2%，接近 OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol（Max）此前 7.8% 纪录的四倍，ARC Prize 团队将其归功于更强的自主探索与规划能力。

items.text: China's MIIT launched a national zero-carbon factory and zero-carbon compute-facility program, requiring such facilities to source at least 95% of energy from non-fossil sources by 2030.
items.text_zh: 中国工信部启动国家级零碳工厂、零碳算力设施建设工作，要求到 2030 年此类设施非化石能源消费占比不低于 95%。

items.text: An ACM survey of 763 computing educators across 49 countries found 68% have overhauled assessments toward proctored exams and oral defenses, as AI tools now solve routine coursework.
items.text_zh: ACM 对 49 个国家 763 名计算机教育者的调查显示，68% 已改革考核方式，转向监考笔试与口头答辩，因为 AI 工具已能完成常规编程作业。

items.text: Monday.com will cut about 20% of its workforce — over 600 roles — in an AI-driven restructuring, becoming the 21st company on TechCrunch's list of 2026 layoffs citing AI.
items.text_zh: Monday.com 将以「AI 驱动重组」为由裁员约 20%（逾 600 人），成为 TechCrunch 统计中 2026 年第 21 家把裁员归因于 AI 的科技公司。

items.text: Andrej Karpathy dismissed viral rumors that he had quit Anthropic as "weird misinformation" after users noticed the company had disappeared from his X bio.
items.text_zh: 网友发现 Andrej Karpathy 的 X 个人简介中不再出现 Anthropic 后，离职传闻疯传，Karpathy 本人回应称这是「离谱的假消息」。

items.text: Owen Song's Inflect-Micro-v2 packs complete local text-to-speech into 9.36 million parameters (37.5MB), generating 24kHz audio on plain CPUs under an Apache-2.0 license.
items.text_zh: Owen Song 发布 Inflect-Micro-v2，仅用 936 万参数（37.5MB）实现完整的本地文本转语音，普通 CPU 即可生成 24kHz 音频，采用 Apache-2.0 开源协议。

items.text: OpenSolon shipped release 2026.7.26 of SolonCode, a fully open-source Java coding agent billed as a Java-8-compatible "Claude Code" offering CLI, web, and desktop IDE interfaces.
items.text_zh: OpenSolon 发布 SolonCode 2026.7.26 版，这一 100% 开源的 Java 编程智能体号称「兼容 Java 8 的 Claude Code」，同时提供 CLI、Web 与桌面 IDE 三种界面。

items.text: Anthropic's status page reported elevated Opus 5 error rates for a second straight day, underscoring capacity strain as launch-weekend demand for the new model surges.
items.text_zh: Anthropic 状态页连续第二天报告 Opus 5 错误率升高，新模型发布周末的需求激增令算力吃紧问题再度凸显。

items.text: MiniMax posted an open-weights manifesto — "Open weights. Open research. Open innovation... Marching for an open future" — as debate intensifies over US restrictions on Chinese open models.
items.text_zh: MiniMax 发文重申开源立场——「开放权重、开放研究、开放创新……向开放的未来进军」，此时美国限制中国开源模型的争论正愈演愈烈。

items.text: PixVerse's enterprise account PixVerse4Biz showcased new AI-generated video ad work on X, declaring that "the creation of AI ads never stops" as it courts brand customers.
items.text_zh: PixVerse 企业号 PixVerse4Biz 在 X 上展示新的 AI 生成视频广告作品，宣称「AI 广告创作永不停歇」，持续吸引品牌客户。

items.text: Microsoft opened public previews of MAI-Image-2.5-Pro, its highest-fidelity image model yet, and MAI-Voice-2-Flash, twice as fast and 32% cheaper than MAI-Voice-2, in Microsoft Foundry.
items.text_zh: 微软在 Foundry 开放两款模型公测：MAI-Image-2.5-Pro 为其迄今保真度最高的图像模型，MAI-Voice-2-Flash 语音模型速度较 MAI-Voice-2 快一倍且便宜 32%。

items.text: Sakana AI released Fugu-Cyber, a cybersecurity orchestration model reporting 86.9% on the CyberGym benchmark and 72.1% on CTI-REALM threat-intelligence tasks.
items.text_zh: Sakana AI 发布网络安全编排模型 Fugu-Cyber，报告在 CyberGym 基准达 86.9%、威胁情报基准 CTI-REALM 达 72.1%。

items.text: Meta's FAIRChem v2 ships UMA, a universal machine-learning interatomic potential covering molecules, catalysts, materials, vibrations and molecular dynamics in a single open model.
items.text_zh: Meta FAIRChem v2 推出 UMA 通用机器学习原子间势，以单一开源模型覆盖分子、催化剂、材料、振动与分子动力学模拟。

items.text: Mitsui Fudosan will build a physical-AI development hub near TSMC's Kumamoto base, using next-generation chips to develop prototypes for industrial applications, Nikkei reports.
items.text_zh: 日经报道：三井不动产将在台积电熊本基地附近建设 physical AI 开发中心，利用新一代芯片开发工业应用原型。

items.text: Japanese power companies plan to build or reinforce about 30 substations to meet surging electricity demand from AI data centers, Nikkei reports.
items.text_zh: 日经报道：日本多家电力公司计划新建或扩建约 30 座变电站，以应对 AI 数据中心激增的用电需求。

items.text: A Nikkei data analysis finds AI-driven cyberattacks now outpace human defenders, with one documented intruder beginning to spread through a network just 27 seconds after entry.
items.text_zh: 日经数据分析：AI 驱动的网络攻击速度已超出人类防御极限，有案例显示入侵者进入网络仅 27 秒即开始横向扩散。

items.text: Terence Tao's slides from his ICM 2026 lecture 'Mathematics in the Age of AI' circulated widely, topping Hacker News with his take on AI's role in mathematical research.
items.text_zh: 陶哲轩在 ICM 2026 国际数学家大会的演讲幻灯片《AI 时代的数学》广泛流传并登上 Hacker News 前列，阐述 AI 在数学研究中的角色。

items.text: Samsung Electronics chairman Lee Jae-yong met OpenAI CEO Sam Altman in San Francisco to discuss AI-semiconductor cooperation, reportedly covering HBM and DRAM supply plans.
items.text_zh: 三星电子会长李在镕在旧金山会见 OpenAI CEO Sam Altman，商讨 AI 半导体合作方案，据悉重点涉及 HBM、DRAM 供应计划。

items.text: Hugging Face posted 'free the parameters' on X, amplifying the open-weights campaign as Washington weighs restrictions on Chinese open models.
items.text_zh: Hugging Face 在 X 发帖“free the parameters”，在华盛顿酝酿限制中国开源模型之际为开放权重阵营声援造势。
